column3: MT 80:1–2; the following verses of this psalm are MT +1. Close to the Hebrew; “Shoshannim Eduth” is rendered “Set to ‘The Lilies.’ A Testimony,” and “who sits [on] the cherubim” “who dwell between the cherubim.”
Close to the Hebrew; “will you smoke” is rendered “will You be angry.”
Close to the Hebrew; שָׁלִישׁ (“by the third-measure”) is rendered “in great measure.”
Close to the Hebrew; “you cleared [ground] before it” is rendered “You prepared room for it.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the mountains” is rendered “The hills,” and “the cedars of God” “the mighty cedars.”
Close to the Hebrew; גְדֵרֶיהָ (“its walls”) is rendered “her hedges,” and NKJV supplies “fruit.”
Close to the Hebrew; יְכַרְסְמֶנָּה (“ravages it”) is rendered “uproots it,” and “moving creatures” “the wild beast.”
Close to the Hebrew; וְכַנָּה (“the stock”) is rendered “the vineyard,” and בֵּן (“the son”) “the branch.”
